## Problem

Describe the concrete failure or workflow gap. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Change and scope

Explain the resulting behavior. For documentation-only changes, state which guidance or wording changed. Note relevant configuration, schema, data or service-call effects; omit categories that do not apply.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results, plus any checks not run and why. Distinguish offline fixtures, builds and live evidence. Include sanitized screenshots for visible changes when useful. Documentation or copy changes do not require credentials or paid service calls.

## Limitations

Describe material remaining gaps or rollout considerations, if any. Keep secrets, signed URLs, private documents and user data out of the pull request.
